_comment: Hand labels for choosing E3's answer judge. Labelled by reading each candidate against its reference under ONE stated rule (see labelling_rule). Recorded so the choice of judge is auditable and overridable rather than resting on one person's taste - flip a label here and re-run simulator/judge_validation/score_judges.py to see whether the conclusion moves.
labelling_rule: correct = the candidate states nothing that conflicts with the reference. Omitting reference detail is correct. Rephrasing, naming the hotel, and added detail are correct unless they contradict a specific fact (time, price, name, number, location). Declining to answer is incorrect. Inventing a specific figure the reference gives differently is incorrect.
source: simulator/e3_sweep_cache/answers, first ~810 cells of the first full sweep
